_comment: The seeded assessment record — the demo subject, and the AssessmentContext every capability is grounded in (SPEC G-65: the service REFUSES a request without one). Answers are insert-only in the real product; this file is the projection. Deliberately consistent with what the instrument would ACTUALLY ASK: G-67 found that a finding on a control an assessment never accumulated is invisible in the reviewer's queue, so seeded data answers only questions that route. Some questions are deliberately LEFT UNANSWERED so the handoff report has a real 'nobody answered this' section and the drafting capability has somewhere to propose.

answers.value: We are introducing Meridian Assist into the customer contact centre. When an agent opens a customer email, Meridian drafts a suggested reply from the customer's account history and our knowledge base. The agent reads the draft, edits it where needed, and sends it. Meridian Assist is a SaaS product hosted by Meridian Data Systems, and their support team in Bengaluru holds administrator access to our tenant. Around 240 contact centre agents will use it, and it will touch roughly 400,000 customer records, including correspondence where customers have told us they are in financial difficulty.

thread.text: I do not know which regulations apply to using a vendor's model on customer correspondence. Can compliance confirm rather than have me guess?

documents.note: Stored as EXTRACTED TEXT ONLY, never as a file (G-66). §3.6 leaves attachment retention open and it blocks S4.6; text scoped to one assessment is a narrower thing than a binary store, with no download path and nothing in it the requester did not already hand over.
